basic_info.description: Enjoy the elegance and thoughtful design of this exceptional southwest facing, three bedroom, two bath Pacific Heights condominium that lives like a single family. A formal entry welcomes you into the main level of this light-filled corner unit, featuring soaring ceilings, recessed lighting, and beautiful hardwood floors throughout. The grand living room is framed by period-detail windows that flood the space with natural light, complemented by custom built-in cabinetry and a working fireplace. A separate dining area connects seamlessly to the fully remodeled kitchen, appointed with stainless steel appliances, Calacatta Gold countertops, and a charming built-in window seat.The full bath on this level has been completely renovated with radiant-heated marble floors, Calacatta counters, and a spacious spa-like shower. The generous primary bedroom offers a full wall of custom built-ins, combining style and practicality. On the lower level, you'll find two additional bedrooms, one ideal as a home office or nursery, along with a second updated full bath. This level also provides direct access to the garage and a private storage room. Located in sought after Pacific Heights, this home is minutes from transportation, the shops and restaurants of Pacific Heights and Presidio Heights.
